description.en:
SATB, MIrZ-Y Muhammad ‘.Ai.I, whose takhullus 
was S.a’H!, a Persian poet, born about 1012 
(1603) near Isfahan, hence called Isfahan!, though 
also called Tabriz!, because his father Mirza ‘.Abd 
al-
description.tr: SÂİB - takma adı Sâib olan Mîrzâ Muhammed Ali, 1012 (1603 M.) civarında İsfahan yakınında doğan Fars şairi, bu nedenle İsfahânî denir, ayrıca Tebrizî de denir.
